name: Tristan
subtitle: Tortured Heart
description: Shield your allies from harm whilst devoting your Protection to Isolde.
lore: Sent to retrieve Princess Isolde, betrothed of King Mark, Sir Tristan instead found himself bound to her by a love potion. They traveled and adventured together, until the Shattering saved them from Mark’s vengeance. Now Tristan ignores his duties to the land as he works to stop Isolde who—for reasons Tristan cannot comprehend—strives to undo the potion’s effects.
